quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (January-December 2025) results: net sales JPY 2,058,832 million (down 0.4%), operating profit JPY 127,465 million (up 1.3%), profit before tax JPY 124,758 million and profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 69,162 million (versus a loss of JPY 94,042 million in FY2024, when the loss on the sale of the Russian business and Biopharmaceuticals CDMO impairment losses were booked). Automotive and Architectural Glass grew sales and profit while Electronics, Chemicals and Life Science declined; management cites Automotive product-mix improvement and pricing policies, lower PVC selling prices in Essential Chemicals and lower EUV photomask blank shipments in Electronic materials. Operating profit bridge: sales volume / price / mix +JPY 19.9 billion, raw material and fuel prices -JPY 4.6 billion, costs and other -JPY 13.7 billion. Sales by location: Japan JPY 652,144 million, Asia JPY 646,856 million, Americas JPY 244,006 million, Europe JPY 515,825 million. No single external customer exceeds 10% of revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 2,058,832 million (-0.4%); operating profit JPY 127,465 million (+1.3%); profit attributable to owners JPY 69,162 million

quarterly_data.signal: Electronics segment FY2025: net sales JPY 355.1 billion (down 2.6%), operating profit JPY 47.5 billion (down 12.7%). Display sales rose on higher LCD glass substrate shipments, while Electronic materials sales fell because optoelectronics was in a transition period toward higher functionality and EUV photomask blank shipments decreased; profit was also hit by costs booked for the decision to exit the chemically strengthened specialty glass business. Management states the Electronics business earns high profitability from highly unique products with high market share as the semiconductor-related market expands, but growth slowed in 2025; semiconductor-related materials broadly kept growing, and for EUV photomask blanks AGC aims to return to a growth trajectory by focusing on development and sales expansion in the leading-edge field; optoelectronics aims to return to growth by executing its transition to higher functionality.
quarterly_data.figure: Electronics net sales JPY 355.1 billion (-2.6%); operating profit JPY 47.5 billion (-12.7%)

quarterly_data.signal: Other segments FY2025 (net sales / operating profit): Architectural Glass JPY 441.1 billion (up 0.7%) / JPY 17.3 billion (up 5.5%), on pricing policies and yen depreciation in Europe and the Americas despite lower European shipments; Automotive JPY 520.6 billion (up 4.4%) / JPY 29.3 billion (up 110.2%), on higher Japanese shipments, mix improvement and pricing policies; Chemicals JPY 584.2 billion (down 1.6%) / JPY 53.0 billion (down 6.6%), as lower PVC prices hit Essential Chemicals while Performance Chemicals grew on pricing policies and higher shipments of fluorine products for electronics and mobility; Life Science JPY 133.1 billion (down 5.8%) / operating loss JPY 22.3 billion, as sales fell on the non-recurrence of one-time income from a contract settlement booked in FY2024 in Biopharmaceuticals CDMO and the closure of the Colorado (US) site, and fixed costs rose from expanded capacity in Europe that started operating in FY2024. Management states Southeast Asian demand (Essential Chemicals) grows about 4% a year, with caustic soda demand rising for alumina and nickel refining in Indonesia, while PVC and caustic soda prices stay low on the weak Chinese economy and India not imposing anti-dumping duties.
quarterly_data.figure: Automotive operating profit JPY 29.3 billion (+110.2%); Chemicals net sales JPY 584.2 billion (-1.6%); Life Science operating loss JPY 22.3 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Management states it has revised its 2026 financial KPIs again: the AGC plus-2026 plan originally set 2026 operating profit of JPY 230 billion and ROE of 8% or more, lowered in February 2025, and now cut further because sales targets were missed in Electronic materials (EUV photomask blanks, optoelectronics) and Life Science and prices are expected to stay weak in Essential Chemicals Southeast Asia. AGC targets ROE of 5% or more in 2026, the plan's final year, and ROE above 8% early from 2027, with company-wide ROCE of 10% or more; Automotive (ROCE above 10% in 2025) aims for ROCE of 15% within a few years and Display for ROCE of 10%; Life Science is expected to turn profitable in 2027. AGC invested more than JPY 200 billion a year in capex from 2018 to 2025, mainly capacity expansion in Chemicals and Life Science; that large-scale investment wound down in 2025, and from 2026 new investment will be sharply curbed to make full use of existing assets.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 ROE target 5% or more; ROE above 8% early from 2027; company-wide ROCE 10% or more; Life Science profitable in 2027

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 capital expenditure JPY 251,279 million: Architectural Glass JPY 33,085 million, Automotive JPY 43,058 million, Electronics JPY 52,937 million (mainly expanding electronic-materials production facilities in Japan), Chemicals JPY 90,197 million (expanding chlor-alkali production in Southeast Asia and fluorine-product production in Japan), Life Science JPY 28,140 million (expanding biopharmaceutical CDMO facilities in Japan). Capex plan for the next year (2026) JPY 190 billion: Architectural Glass JPY 27 billion (glass furnace repair), Automotive JPY 33 billion (added automotive glass processing lines), Electronics JPY 47 billion (display furnace repair, expanded electronic-materials production equipment), Chemicals JPY 48 billion (fluorine-product capacity expansion), Life Science JPY 33 billion (biopharmaceutical CDMO capacity expansion), Ceramics / other JPY 2 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 capex JPY 251,279 million (Electronics JPY 52,937 million); 2026 capex plan JPY 190 billion (Electronics JPY 47 billion)

quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor strategy and R&D: management states that in front-end semiconductor manufacturing AGC has supplied materials centred on EUV photomask blanks and CMP slurry; it will keep strengthening the front end while focusing on the back end, introducing new technologies and products, and in particular expanding semiconductor packaging-related technologies and solutions, drawing on its combined inorganic and organic materials and design / processing technologies. R&D priorities: next-generation and new products (IR cut filters, EUV photomask blanks, glass core, automotive panels) and new businesses (semiconductor process materials, battery materials, drug delivery systems). FY2025 R&D expenses JPY 60,324 million, of which Corporate JPY 20,013 million, Electronics JPY 13,326 million (mainly materials for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, display and optoelectronic materials) and Chemicals JPY 11,271 million.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 R&D JPY 60,324 million; Electronics R&D JPY 13,326 million
